        <script><![CDATA[var synergizeDemoUtils = Class.create();
synergizeDemoUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {


    fetchWorkNotes: function(incidentSysId) {
        try {
            if (!incidentSysId || typeof incidentSysId !== 'string') {
                throw new Error('Invalid incident sys_id provided');
            }
            var incWorkNotes = '';

            var gr = new GlideRecordSecure('sys_journal_field');
            gr.addQuery('element_id', incidentSysId);
            gr.addQuery('name', 'incident');
            gr.addQuery('element', 'work_notes');
            gr.orderBy('sys_created_on');
            gr.setLimit(1000);
            gr.query();

            while (gr.next()) {
                var timestamp = gr.getDisplayValue('sys_created_on');
                var workNote = gr.getValue('value');

                incWorkNotes +=
                    '[' + timestamp + ']\n' +
                    workNote + '\n' +
                    '-------------------------------------------------------\n';
            }

            if (!incWorkNotes) {
                incWorkNotes = 'No work notes found for the incident.';
            }

        } catch (ex) {
            gs.error(
                'Error fetching work notes for incident ' +
                incidentSysId + ': ' + ex.message
            );

            incWorkNotes = 'Unable to retrieve work notes: ' + ex.message;
        }
        return incWorkNotes;

    },

    findDuplicateIncidents: function(incidentSysId) {
        //Pass any single incident sys ID
        var response = {
            success: false,
            sourceIncident: '',
            duplicateFound: false,
            resultCount: 0,
            results: [],
            message: ''
        };

        try {
            var lookbackDays = 30; //Number of days to fetch incidents
            var minimumScore = 40;
            var maximumResults = 10;

            if (!incidentSysId || typeof incidentSysId !== 'string') {
                response.message = 'Invalid incident sys_id provided.';
                return response;
            }

            var sourceGR = new GlideRecordSecure('incident');

            if (!sourceGR.get(incidentSysId)) {
                response.message =
                    'Incident not found or access denied: ' +
                    incidentSysId;

                return response;
            }

            response.sourceIncident =
                sourceGR.getDisplayValue('number');

            var sourceData = {
                shortDescription: sourceGR.getValue('short_description') || '',
                description: sourceGR.getValue('description') || '',
                caller: sourceGR.getValue('caller_id') || '',
                configurationItem: sourceGR.getValue('cmdb_ci') || '',
                businessService: sourceGR.getValue('business_service') || '',
                serviceOffering: sourceGR.getValue('service_offering') || '',
                category: sourceGR.getValue('category') || '',
                subcategory: sourceGR.getValue('subcategory') || '',
                assignmentGroup: sourceGR.getValue('assignment_group') || '',
                location: sourceGR.getValue('location') || '',
                contactType: sourceGR.getValue('contact_type') || '',
                openedAt: sourceGR.getValue('opened_at') ||
                    sourceGR.getValue('sys_created_on') || '',
                correlationId: ''
            };

            if (sourceGR.isValidField('correlation_id')) {
                sourceData.correlationId =
                    sourceGR.getValue('correlation_id') || '';
            }

            var candidateGR =
                new GlideRecordSecure('incident');

            candidateGR.addQuery(
                'sys_id',
                '!=',
                incidentSysId
            );

            candidateGR.addQuery(
                'opened_at',
                '>=',
                gs.daysAgoStart(lookbackDays)
            );

            candidateGR.addQuery('active', true);

            var contextConditions = [];

            if (sourceData.configurationItem) {
                contextConditions.push(
                    'cmdb_ci=' +
                    sourceData.configurationItem
                );
            }

            if (sourceData.businessService) {
                contextConditions.push(
                    'business_service=' +
                    sourceData.businessService
                );
            }

            if (sourceData.serviceOffering) {
                contextConditions.push(
                    'service_offering=' +
                    sourceData.serviceOffering
                );
            }

            if (sourceData.correlationId) {
                contextConditions.push(
                    'correlation_id=' +
                    sourceData.correlationId
                );
            }

            if (sourceData.category) {
                contextConditions.push(
                    'category=' +
                    sourceData.category
                );
            }

            if (sourceData.subcategory) {
                contextConditions.push(
                    'subcategory=' +
                    sourceData.subcategory
                );
            }

            if (sourceData.shortDescription) {
                var searchWords =
                    sourceData.shortDescription
                    .toLowerCase()
                    .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g, ' ')
                    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
                    .replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '')
                    .split(' ');

                var ignoredWords = {
                    'a': true,
                    'an': true,
                    'and': true,
                    'are': true,
                    'for': true,
                    'from': true,
                    'has': true,
                    'have': true,
                    'in': true,
                    'is': true,
                    'it': true,
                    'not': true,
                    'of': true,
                    'on': true,
                    'or': true,
                    'the': true,
                    'this': true,
                    'to': true,
                    'user': true,
                    'with': true
                };

                var textWordCount = 0;

                for (
                    var wordIndex = 0; wordIndex < searchWords.length; wordIndex++
                ) {
                    var searchWord =
                        searchWords[wordIndex];

                    if (
                        searchWord.length >= 4 &&
                        !ignoredWords[searchWord]
                    ) {
                        contextConditions.push(
                            'short_descriptionLIKE' +
                            searchWord
                        );

                        textWordCount++;

                        if (textWordCount >= 3) {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (contextConditions.length === 0) {
                response.message =
                    'Incident does not contain enough information ' +
                    'to identify duplicate candidates.';

                return response;
            }

            candidateGR.addEncodedQuery(
                contextConditions.join('^OR')
            );

            candidateGR.orderByDesc('opened_at');
            candidateGR.setLimit(500);
            candidateGR.query();

            while (candidateGR.next()) {
                var candidateData = {
                    shortDescription: candidateGR.getValue(
                        'short_description'
                    ) || '',

                    description: candidateGR.getValue(
                        'description'
                    ) || '',

                    caller: candidateGR.getValue(
                        'caller_id'
                    ) || '',

                    configurationItem: candidateGR.getValue(
                        'cmdb_ci'
                    ) || '',

                    businessService: candidateGR.getValue(
                        'business_service'
                    ) || '',

                    serviceOffering: candidateGR.getValue(
                        'service_offering'
                    ) || '',

                    category: candidateGR.getValue(
                        'category'
                    ) || '',

                    subcategory: candidateGR.getValue(
                        'subcategory'
                    ) || '',

                    assignmentGroup: candidateGR.getValue(
                        'assignment_group'
                    ) || '',

                    location: candidateGR.getValue(
                        'location'
                    ) || '',

                    contactType: candidateGR.getValue(
                        'contact_type'
                    ) || '',

                    openedAt: candidateGR.getValue(
                            'opened_at'
                        ) ||
                        candidateGR.getValue(
                            'sys_created_on'
                        ) || '',

                    correlationId: ''
                };

                if (
                    candidateGR.isValidField(
                        'correlation_id'
                    )
                ) {
                    candidateData.correlationId =
                        candidateGR.getValue(
                            'correlation_id'
                        ) || '';
                }

                var evaluation =
                    this._calculateDuplicateScore(
                        sourceData,
                        candidateData
                    );

                if (evaluation.score < minimumScore) {
                    continue;
                }

                response.results.push({
                    sysId: candidateGR.getUniqueValue(),

                    number: candidateGR.getDisplayValue(
                        'number'
                    ),

                    shortDescription: candidateGR.getDisplayValue(
                        'short_description'
                    ),

                    caller: candidateGR.getDisplayValue(
                        'caller_id'
                    ),

                    configurationItem: candidateGR.getDisplayValue(
                        'cmdb_ci'
                    ),

                    businessService: candidateGR.getDisplayValue(
                        'business_service'
                    ),

                    serviceOffering: candidateGR.getDisplayValue(
                        'service_offering'
                    ),

                    category: candidateGR.getDisplayValue(
                        'category'
                    ),

                    subcategory: candidateGR.getDisplayValue(
                        'subcategory'
                    ),

                    state: candidateGR.getDisplayValue(
                        'state'
                    ),

                    priority: candidateGR.getDisplayValue(
                        'priority'
                    ),

                    openedAt: candidateGR.getDisplayValue(
                        'opened_at'
                    ),

                    score: evaluation.score,
                    confidence: evaluation.confidence,
                    shortDescriptionSimilarity: evaluation.shortDescriptionSimilarity,
                    descriptionSimilarity: evaluation.descriptionSimilarity,
                    reasons: evaluation.reasons
                });
            }

            response.results.sort(
                function(firstResult, secondResult) {
                    return secondResult.score -
                        firstResult.score;
                }
            );

            if (response.results.length > maximumResults) {
                response.results =
                    response.results.slice(
                        0,
                        maximumResults
                    );
            }

            response.success = true;

            response.duplicateFound =
                response.results.length > 0;

            response.resultCount =
                response.results.length;

            response.message = response.duplicateFound ?
                'Potential duplicate incidents found.' :
                'No potential duplicate incidents found.';

            return response;

        } catch (ex) {
            gs.error(
                'Error in findDuplicateIncidents: ' +
                ex.message
            );

            response.message =
                'Error finding duplicate incidents: ' +
                ex.message;

            return response;
        }
    },


    _calculateDuplicateScore: function(
        sourceData,
        candidateData
    ) {
        var score = 0;
        var reasons = [];

        var shortSimilarity =
            this._getDuplicateTextSimilarity(
                sourceData.shortDescription,
                candidateData.shortDescription
            );

        var descriptionSimilarity =
            this._getDuplicateTextSimilarity(
                sourceData.description,
                candidateData.description
            );

        if (shortSimilarity >= 0.90) {
            score += 40;
            reasons.push(
                'Short Description is almost identical'
            );
        } else if (shortSimilarity >= 0.75) {
            score += 32;
            reasons.push(
                'Short Description is highly similar'
            );
        } else if (shortSimilarity >= 0.55) {
            score += 22;
            reasons.push(
                'Short Description is moderately similar'
            );
        } else if (shortSimilarity >= 0.35) {
            score += 10;
            reasons.push(
                'Short Description contains related terms'
            );
        }

        if (descriptionSimilarity >= 0.85) {
            score += 30;
            reasons.push(
                'Description is highly similar'
            );
        } else if (descriptionSimilarity >= 0.65) {
            score += 22;
            reasons.push(
                'Description is similar'
            );
        } else if (descriptionSimilarity >= 0.40) {
            score += 12;
            reasons.push(
                'Description contains related terms'
            );
        }

        if (
            sourceData.configurationItem &&
            candidateData.configurationItem &&
            sourceData.configurationItem ===
            candidateData.configurationItem
        ) {
            score += 25;
            reasons.push(
                'Same Configuration Item'
            );
        }

        if (
            sourceData.businessService &&
            candidateData.businessService &&
            sourceData.businessService ===
            candidateData.businessService
        ) {
            score += 18;
            reasons.push(
                'Same Business Service'
            );
        }

        if (
            sourceData.serviceOffering &&
            candidateData.serviceOffering &&
            sourceData.serviceOffering ===
            candidateData.serviceOffering
        ) {
            score += 15;
            reasons.push(
                'Same Service Offering'
            );
        }

        if (
            sourceData.category &&
            candidateData.category &&
            sourceData.category ===
            candidateData.category
        ) {
            score += 8;
            reasons.push('Same Category');
        }

        if (
            sourceData.subcategory &&
            candidateData.subcategory &&
            sourceData.subcategory ===
            candidateData.subcategory
        ) {
            score += 8;
            reasons.push('Same Subcategory');
        }

        if (
            sourceData.location &&
            candidateData.location &&
            sourceData.location ===
            candidateData.location
        ) {
            score += 5;
            reasons.push('Same Location');
        }

        if (
            sourceData.assignmentGroup &&
            candidateData.assignmentGroup &&
            sourceData.assignmentGroup ===
            candidateData.assignmentGroup
        ) {
            score += 4;
            reasons.push(
                'Same Assignment Group'
            );
        }

        if (
            sourceData.caller &&
            candidateData.caller &&
            sourceData.caller ===
            candidateData.caller
        ) {
            score += 5;
            reasons.push('Same Caller');
        }

        if (
            sourceData.caller &&
            candidateData.caller &&
            sourceData.caller !==
            candidateData.caller
        ) {
            reasons.push(
                'Raised by a different Caller'
            );
        }

        if (
            sourceData.correlationId &&
            candidateData.correlationId &&
            sourceData.correlationId ===
            candidateData.correlationId
        ) {
            score += 45;
            reasons.push(
                'Same Correlation ID'
            );
        }

        if (
            sourceData.openedAt &&
            candidateData.openedAt
        ) {
            var sourceDate =
                new GlideDateTime(
                    sourceData.openedAt
                );

            var candidateDate =
                new GlideDateTime(
                    candidateData.openedAt
                );

            var difference = Math.abs(
                sourceDate.getNumericValue() -
                candidateDate.getNumericValue()
            );

            var minutesApart =
                Math.floor(difference / 60000);

            if (minutesApart <= 5) {
                score += 15;
                reasons.push(
                    'Opened within 5 minutes'
                );
            } else if (minutesApart <= 30) {
                score += 10;
                reasons.push(
                    'Opened within 30 minutes'
                );
            } else if (minutesApart <= 1440) {
                score += 5;
                reasons.push(
                    'Opened within 24 hours'
                );
            }
        }

        if (
            sourceData.configurationItem &&
            candidateData.configurationItem &&
            sourceData.configurationItem !==
            candidateData.configurationItem
        ) {
            score -= 10;
            reasons.push(
                'Different Configuration Items'
            );
        }

        if (
            sourceData.businessService &&
            candidateData.businessService &&
            sourceData.businessService !==
            candidateData.businessService
        ) {
            score -= 6;
            reasons.push(
                'Different Business Services'
            );
        }

        var hasStrongTextMatch =
            shortSimilarity >= 0.55 ||
            descriptionSimilarity >= 0.65;

        var hasStrongContextMatch =
            sourceData.configurationItem &&
            candidateData.configurationItem &&
            sourceData.configurationItem ===
            candidateData.configurationItem;

        var hasServiceMatch =
            sourceData.businessService &&
            candidateData.businessService &&
            sourceData.businessService ===
            candidateData.businessService;

        var hasOfferingMatch =
            sourceData.serviceOffering &&
            candidateData.serviceOffering &&
            sourceData.serviceOffering ===
            candidateData.serviceOffering;

        var hasCorrelationMatch =
            sourceData.correlationId &&
            candidateData.correlationId &&
            sourceData.correlationId ===
            candidateData.correlationId;

        if (
            !hasStrongTextMatch &&
            !hasStrongContextMatch &&
            !hasServiceMatch &&
            !hasOfferingMatch &&
            !hasCorrelationMatch
        ) {
            score = 0;
            reasons.push(
                'No strong duplicate indicator found'
            );
        }

        if (score < 0) {
            score = 0;
        }

        if (score > 100) {
            score = 100;
        }

        var confidence = 'Low';

        if (score >= 80) {
            confidence = 'Very High';
        } else if (score >= 65) {
            confidence = 'High';
        } else if (score >= 40) {
            confidence = 'Medium';
        }

        return {
            score: score,

            confidence: confidence,

            shortDescriptionSimilarity: Math.round(
                shortSimilarity / 0.01
            ),

            descriptionSimilarity: Math.round(
                descriptionSimilarity / 0.01
            ),

            reasons: reasons
        };
    },


    _getDuplicateTextSimilarity: function(
        firstText,
        secondText
    ) {
        var stopWords = {
            'a': true,
            'an': true,
            'and': true,
            'are': true,
            'as': true,
            'at': true,
            'be': true,
            'by': true,
            'for': true,
            'from': true,
            'has': true,
            'have': true,
            'i': true,
            'in': true,
            'is': true,
            'it': true,
            'of': true,
            'on': true,
            'or': true,
            'the': true,
            'this': true,
            'to': true,
            'user': true,
            'with': true
        };

        var synonyms = {
            'failure': 'fail',
            'failed': 'fail',
            'failing': 'fail',
            'unavailable': 'down',
            'outage': 'down',
            'cannot': 'unable',
            'cant': 'unable',
            'login': 'logon',
            'signin': 'logon',
            'signon': 'logon',
            'mail': 'email',
            'emails': 'email',
            'applications': 'application',
            'apps': 'application',
            'servers': 'server',
            'errors': 'error'
        };

        function createTokenSet(text) {
            var normalizedText =
                String(text || '')
                .toLowerCase()
                .replace(
                    /[^a-z0-9\s]/g,
                    ' '
                )
                .replace(
                    /\s+/g,
                    ' '
                )
                .replace(
                    /^\s+|\s+$/g,
                    ''
                );

            var tokenSet = {};

            if (!normalizedText) {
                return tokenSet;
            }

            var tokens =
                normalizedText.split(' ');

            for (var index = 0; index < tokens.length; index++) {

                var token = tokens[index];

                if (
                    token.length < 2 ||
                    stopWords[token]
                ) {
                    continue;
                }

                token = synonyms[token] || token;
                tokenSet[token] = true;
            }

            return tokenSet;
        }

        var firstSet =
            createTokenSet(firstText);

        var secondSet =
            createTokenSet(secondText);

        var intersection = 0;
        var union = 0;
        var tokenName;

        for (tokenName in firstSet) {
            if (
                firstSet.hasOwnProperty(
                    tokenName
                )
            ) {
                union++;

                if (secondSet[tokenName]) {
                    intersection++;
                }
            }
        }

        for (tokenName in secondSet) {
            if (
                secondSet.hasOwnProperty(
                    tokenName
                ) &&
                !firstSet[tokenName]
            ) {
                union++;
            }
        }

        if (union === 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        return intersection / union;
    },


    formatDuplicateIncidents: function(duplicateResult) {
        var formattedLines = [];

        try {
            if (!duplicateResult) {
                return 'No potential duplicate incidents found.';
            }

            if (typeof duplicateResult === 'string') {
                duplicateResult = JSON.parse(duplicateResult);
            }

            var results = duplicateResult.results || [];

            for (
                var index = 0; index < results.length; index++
            ) {
                var incident = results[index];

                var incidentNumber =
                    incident.number || 'Unknown Incident';

                var reasons = incident.reasons || [];

                formattedLines.push(
                    incidentNumber +
                    ': ' +
                    reasons.join(', ')
                );
            }

            if (formattedLines.length === 0) {
                return 'No potential duplicate incidents found.';
            }

            return formattedLines.join('\n');

        } catch (ex) {
            gs.error(
                'Error in formatDuplicateIncidents: ' +
                ex.message
            );

            return 'Unable to format duplicate incidents: ' +
                ex.message;
        }
    },


    addQualitySuggestionsToWorkNotes: function() {

        var incidentSysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_incid');
        var nowAssistSuggestion = this.getParameter('sysparm_nowassistsuggestion');
        var plainText = String(nowAssistSuggestion || '');

        plainText = plainText
            .replace(/</gi, '<')
            .replace(/>/gi, '>')
            .replace(/"/gi, '"')
            .replace(/'/gi, "'")
            .replace(/'/gi, "'")
            .replace(/ /gi, ' ')
            .replace(/&/gi, '&');

        plainText = plainText
            .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n')
            .replace(/<\/p>/gi, '\n\n')

    applyUpdates: function() {
        var sysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_incident_sys_id');
        var shortDescription = this.getParameter('sysparm_short_description');
        var description = this.getParameter('sysparm_description');
        var businessService = this.getParameter('sysparm_business_service');
        var category = this.getParameter('sysparm_category');
        var priority = this.getParameter('sysparm_priority');
        var channel = this.getParameter('sysparm_channel');
        var closeCode = this.getParameter('sysparm_close_code');
        var closeNote = this.getParameter('sysparm_close_note');
        var workNotes = this.getParameter('sysparm_work_notes');
        var qualityScore = this.getParameter('sysparm_quality_score');
        var aiResolutionPlan = this.getParameter('sysparm_ai_resolution_plan');

        if (!sysId) {
            return JSON.stringify({
                success: false,
                message: 'Incident Sys ID is missing.'
            });
        }

        var incident = new GlideRecordSecure('incident');

        if (!incident.get(sysId) || !incident.canWrite()) {
            return JSON.stringify({
                success: false,
                message: 'Incident not found or update not permitted.'
            });
        }

        if (shortDescription && shortDescription !== 'NO_CHANGE') {
            incident.setValue('short_description', shortDescription);
        }

        if (description && description !== 'NO_CHANGE') {
            incident.setValue('description', description);
        }

        // if (
        //     businessService &&
        //     businessService !== 'NO_CHANGE' &&
        //     businessService !== 'Manual Review Required'
        // ) {
        //     incident.business_service.setDisplayValue(businessService);
        // }

        if (category && category !== 'NO_CHANGE') {
            incident.category.setDisplayValue(category);
        }

        if (priority && /^[1-5]$/.test(priority)) {
            incident.setValue('priority', priority);
        }

        if (channel && channel !== 'NO_CHANGE') {
            incident.contact_type.setDisplayValue(channel);
        }

        if (closeCode && closeCode !== 'NO_CHANGE') {
            incident.close_code.setDisplayValue(closeCode);
        }

        if (closeNote && closeNote !== 'NO_CHANGE') {
            incident.setValue('close_notes', closeNote);
        }

        if (workNotes && workNotes !== 'NO_CHANGE') {
            incident.setValue('work_notes', workNotes);

            /^(100|[0-9]{1,2})(\.[0-9]+)?$/.test(qualityScore)
        ) {
            incident.setValue('u_audit_score', qualityScore);
        }

        }

            return JSON.stringify({

    //Document Generator

    generateDocument: function(incidentSysId) {

        /*

        Use as per below 

        var incidentSysId = 'a83820b58f723300e7e16c7827bdeed2';
        var generator = new x_938076_now_utils.IncidentRCADocumentGenerator();
        var result = generator.generateDocument(incidentSysId);
        gs.info(JSON.stringify(result));
        
        */

        try {
            if (gs.nil(incidentSysId)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    message: 'Incident Sys ID was not provided.'
                };
            }

            var incidentGR = new GlideRecord('incident');

            if (!incidentGR.get(incidentSysId)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    message: 'Incident record was not found.'
                };
            }

            var templateAttachmentSysId = gs.getProperty('word_generate_Template');

            if (gs.nil(templateAttachmentSysId)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    message: 'Template attachment property is empty.'
                };
            }

            var templateAttachmentGR = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');

            if (!templateAttachmentGR.get(templateAttachmentSysId)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    message: 'Template attachment was not found.'
                };
            }

            var attachmentAPI = new GlideSysAttachment();

            var inputStream = attachmentAPI.getContentStream(
                templateAttachmentSysId
            );

            var textReader = new GlideTextReader(inputStream);
            var contentLines = [];
            var line;

            while ((line = textReader.readLine()) !== null) {
                contentLines.push(line);
            }

            var generatedContent = contentLines.join('\n');

            if (gs.nil(generatedContent)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    message: 'Unable to read the template content.'
                };
            }

            var replacements = {
                '${number}': incidentGR.getDisplayValue('number'),
                '${short_description}': incidentGR.getDisplayValue('short_description'),
                '${description}': incidentGR.getDisplayValue('description'),
                '${priority}': incidentGR.getDisplayValue('priority'),
                '${state}': incidentGR.getDisplayValue('state'),
                '${contact_type}': incidentGR.getDisplayValue('contact_type'),
                '${configuration_item}': incidentGR.getDisplayValue('cmdb_ci'),
                '${assignment_group}': incidentGR.getDisplayValue('assignment_group'),
                '${assigned_to}': incidentGR.getDisplayValue('assigned_to'),
                '${opened_by}': incidentGR.getDisplayValue('opened_by'),
                '${opened_at}': incidentGR.getDisplayValue('opened_at'),
                '${close_notes}': incidentGR.getDisplayValue('close_notes')
            };

            for (var placeholder in replacements) {
                if (replacements.hasOwnProperty(placeholder)) {
                    generatedContent = this._replaceAll(
                        generatedContent,
                        placeholder,
                        this._prepareValue(replacements[placeholder])
                    );
                }
            }

            /*
             * For the initial test, generate an HTML file.
             * This avoids the MIME-type validation issue encountered earlier.
             */
            var outputFileName =
                'Incident_Report_' +
                incidentGR.getValue('number') +
                '.html';

            var generatedAttachmentSysId = attachmentAPI.write(
                incidentGR,
                outputFileName,
                'text/html',
                generatedContent
            );

            if (gs.nil(generatedAttachmentSysId)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    message: 'The generated document could not be attached.'
                };
            }

            return {
                success: true,
                message: outputFileName +
                    ' was generated and attached successfully.',
                attachmentSysId: generatedAttachmentSysId
            };

        } catch (exception) {

            gs.error(
                'IncidentWordDocumentGenerator error: ' +
                exception.message
            );

            return {
                success: false,
                message: 'Document generation failed: ' +
                    exception.message
            };
        }
    },

    _replaceAll: function(content, placeholder, replacementValue) {
        return content.split(placeholder).join(replacementValue);
    },

    _prepareValue: function(value) {

        if (gs.nil(value)) {
            return '';
        }

        return this._escapeHTML(value.toString())
            .replace(/\r\n/g, '<br/>')
            .replace(/\n/g, '<br/>')
            .replace(/\r/g, '<br/>');
    },

    _escapeHTML: function(value) {

        return value
            .replace(/&/g, '&')
            .replace(/</g, '<')
            .replace(/>/g, '>')
            .replace(/"/g, '"')
            .replace(/'/g, ''');
    },

    createProblemFromIncident: function(incidentSysId) {


        /*Usage 

					var incidentSysId =
				'd956ea98c3094b10ff446a3bb00131d0';

			var creator =
				new sn_itsm_gen_ai.synergizeDemoUtils();

			var result =
				creator.createProblemFromIncident(
					incidentSysId
				);

			gs.info(
				'[Problem Creation Result] ' +
				JSON.stringify(result)

				
			);

			gs.info('[Problem Creation Result] ' +
				JSON.stringify(result.childResolutionNotes))

		*/

        try {
            if (gs.nil(incidentSysId)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    message: 'Incident Sys ID was not provided.',
                    problemSysId: '',
                    problemNumber: '',
                    childIncidentNumbers: [],
                    childResolutionNotes: []
                };
            }

            /*
             * Retrieve the source incident.
             */
            var incidentGR = new GlideRecord('incident');

            if (!incidentGR.get(incidentSysId)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    message: 'Incident was not found.',
                    problemSysId: '',
                    problemNumber: '',
                    childIncidentNumbers: [],
                    childResolutionNotes: []
                };
            }

            /*
             * Check whether the incident is already linked
             * to an existing Problem.
             */
            if (
                incidentGR.isValidField('problem_id') &&
                !gs.nil(incidentGR.getValue('problem_id'))
            ) {
                var existingProblemGR =
                    new GlideRecord('problem');

                if (
                    existingProblemGR.get(
                        incidentGR.getValue('problem_id')
                    )
                ) {
                    var existingChildData =
                        this._getChildIncidentData(
                            incidentGR.getUniqueValue()
                        );

                    return {
                        success: false,
                        message: incidentGR.getValue('number') +
                            ' is already linked to Problem ' +
                            existingProblemGR.getValue('number') +
                            '.',
                        problemSysId: existingProblemGR.getUniqueValue(),
                        problemNumber: existingProblemGR.getValue('number'),
                        childIncidentNumbers: existingChildData.childIncidentNumbers,
                        childResolutionNotes: existingChildData.childResolutionNotes
                    };
                }
            }

            /*
             * Collect the child incidents and their
             * resolution notes before creating the Problem.
             */
            var childData =
                this._getChildIncidentData(
                    incidentGR.getUniqueValue()
                );

            /*
             * Create the Problem record directly.
             *
             * This avoids calling the package-private
             * ProblemV2Util Script Include.
             */
            var problemGR = new GlideRecord('problem');
            problemGR.initialize();

            /*
             * Copy the commonly mapped OOTB fields from
             * Incident to Problem.
             *
             * Only fields that exist on both tables
             * are copied.
             */
            var fieldsToCopy = [
                'short_description',
                'description',
                'cmdb_ci',
                'impact',
                'urgency',
                'priority',
                'assignment_group',
                'assigned_to',
                'company',
                'location',
                'business_service',
                'service_offering',
                'category',
                'subcategory'
            ];

            for (
                var fieldIndex = 0; fieldIndex < fieldsToCopy.length; fieldIndex++
            ) {
                var fieldName = fieldsToCopy[fieldIndex];

                if (
                    incidentGR.isValidField(fieldName) &&
                    problemGR.isValidField(fieldName)
                ) {
                    var fieldValue =
                        incidentGR.getValue(fieldName);

                    if (!gs.nil(fieldValue)) {
                        problemGR.setValue(
                            fieldName,
                            fieldValue
                        );
                    }
                }
            }

            /*
             * Add source Incident information to the
             * Problem description.
             */
            var sourceIncidentInformation =
                '\n\nSource Incident: ' +
                incidentGR.getValue('number');

            if (childData.childIncidentNumbers.length > 0) {
                sourceIncidentInformation +=
                    '\nChild Incidents: ' +
                    childData.childIncidentNumbers.join(', ');
            }

            var currentDescription =
                problemGR.getValue('description') || '';

            problemGR.setValue(
                'description',
                currentDescription +
                sourceIncidentInformation
            );

            /*
             * Insert the Problem.
             */
            var problemSysId = problemGR.insert();

            if (gs.nil(problemSysId)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    message: 'Problem record could not be created.',
                    problemSysId: '',
                    problemNumber: '',
                    childIncidentNumbers: childData.childIncidentNumbers,
                    childResolutionNotes: childData.childResolutionNotes
                };
            }

            /*
             * Reload the Problem to retrieve the generated number.
             */
            if (!problemGR.get(problemSysId)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    message: 'Problem was created, but it could not be reloaded.',
                    problemSysId: problemSysId.toString(),
                    problemNumber: '',
                    childIncidentNumbers: childData.childIncidentNumbers,
                    childResolutionNotes: childData.childResolutionNotes
                };
            }

            /*
             * Link the supplied parent Incident to
             * the newly created Problem.
             */
            if (incidentGR.isValidField('problem_id')) {
                incidentGR.setValue(
                    'problem_id',
                    problemSysId
                );

                incidentGR.update();
            }

            return {
                success: true,

                message: problemGR.getValue('number') +
                    ' was created successfully from ' +
                    incidentGR.getValue('number') +
                    '.',

                sourceIncidentNumber: incidentGR.getValue('number'),
                problemSysId: problemSysId.toString(),
                problemNumber: problemGR.getValue('number'),
                childIncidentCount: childData.childIncidentNumbers.length,
                childIncidentNumbers: childData.childIncidentNumbers,
                childResolutionNotes: childData.childResolutionNotes
            };

        } catch (exception) {

            gs.error(
                '[IncidentProblemCreator] ' +
                'Problem creation failed for Incident Sys ID: ' +
                incidentSysId +
                '. Error: ' +
                exception.message
            );

            return {
                success: false,
                message: 'Problem creation failed: ' +
                    exception.message,
                problemSysId: '',
                problemNumber: '',
                childIncidentNumbers: [],
                childResolutionNotes: []
            };
        }
    },

    /**
     * Retrieves only the direct child incidents of the
     * supplied parent Incident.
     *
     * Resolution notes are read from close_notes.
     */
    _getChildIncidentData: function(parentIncidentSysId) {

        var childIncidentNumbers = [];
        var childResolutionNotes = [];

        var childIncidentGR =
            new GlideRecord('incident');

        childIncidentGR.addQuery(
            'parent_incident',
            parentIncidentSysId
        );

        childIncidentGR.orderBy('number');
        childIncidentGR.query();

        while (childIncidentGR.next()) {

            var incidentNumber =
                childIncidentGR.getValue('number') || '';

            var resolutionNote = '';

            /*
             * Standard Incident Resolution notes field.
             */
            if (
                childIncidentGR.isValidField('close_notes')
            ) {
                resolutionNote =
                    childIncidentGR.getValue(
                        'close_notes'
                    ) || '';
            }

            /*
             * Array 1: Child incident numbers.
             */
            childIncidentNumbers.push(
                incidentNumber
            );

            /*
             * Array 2: Child incident resolution notes.
             *
             * Every child is included even when its
             * Resolution notes field is empty.
             */
            childResolutionNotes.push(
                incidentNumber +
                ': ' +
                (
                    gs.nil(resolutionNote) ?
                    'No resolution notes available' :
                    resolutionNote
                )
            );
        }

        return {
            childIncidentNumbers: childIncidentNumbers,

            childResolutionNotes: childResolutionNotes
        };
    },

    decodeBase64Files: function(base64String, gr, outputFileName) { //EL layer has to send us with data:image/jpeg;base64

        var mime = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'; // default if unknown
        var fileExt = 'docx'; // default extension

        // If Base64 has prefix like "data:application/pdf;base64,..."
        if (base64String && base64String.startsWith('data:')) {
            mime = base64String.substring(
                base64String.indexOf(":") + 1,
                base64String.indexOf(";")
            ); // "application/pdf", "image/png", "application/vnd.ms-excel"
            base64String = base64String.split(',')[1]; // strip prefix
        }

        // MIME map //add more extensions if needed
        var mimeMap = {
            "image/png": "png",
            "image/jpeg": "jpg",
            "image/jpg": "jpg",
            "image/gif": "gif",
            "application/pdf": "pdf",
            "application/vnd.ms-excel": "xls",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet": "xlsx",
            "application/msword": "doc",
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": "docx",
            "text/plain": "txt",
            "text/csv": "csv"
        };

        if (mimeMap[mime]) {
            fileExt = mimeMap[mime];
        }

        if (base64String) {
            var base64Bytes = GlideStringUtil.base64DecodeAsBytes(base64String);


            if (base64Bytes) {
                var attachment = new GlideSysAttachment();
                var fileName = outputFileName + fileExt;

                var attachmentSysId = attachment.write(gr, fileName, mime, base64Bytes);

                if (attachmentSysId) {
                    gs.info("Attachment created with sys_id: " + attachmentSysId + " (" + fileName + ")");
                    return 'success';
                } else {
                    gs.error("Failed to create attachment.");
                    return 'failed';
                }
            } else {
                gs.error("Failed to decode Base64 string. Check its format.");
                return 'failed';
            }
        }

    },
